claims.statement: Standard Monthly Paid-Hours Calculation Basis & Formula: 209 hours/month [(40 regular weekly hours + 8 paid weekly holiday hours) / 7 × (365 / 12) = 209 hours]. Formula: KRW 10,320 × 209 hours = KRW 2,156,880.

claims.statement: Standard Monthly Minimum-Wage Benchmark Clarification: KRW 2,156,880/month is the standard monthly minimum-wage benchmark (statutory wage floor), NOT a guaranteed complete E-9 salary. Excludes overtime, night premiums, holiday premiums, and bonuses.
